CI-RS public checksum verification: independent scoped RED and bounded source transition.

Root replayed the additive holder 2baadfa77609195a4c90a1e68abc8d086269bf09 with reviewed context correction 5bfb2edf99dcec7d7d968e5061adbfacde27f9f6 and producer-cache correction 6211c63654dab4c194fe892bf7b0683b74949754 against immutable publisher source 0fb62a11094a07d99d5ca41e09db6b323655da51. Holder SHA256 99b98cc6156fb3992f7f77cffafec6cff6f0d37981b295e3ca1e83433b0e5656; test entrypoint dfdeffd9913562923db4cd19a13417f50a95ca9418b88304a1c97f5eb3ac020c. The exact entrypoint ran 102.502 seconds: 8 RUN, 8 FAIL, 0 SKIP (seven cases and parent), without preparation or cleanup failure. All seven actual probe invocations reached the subject and omitted the mandatory ordinary public Go verification. The independent actual signed-log prerequisites completed with exit codes 0/1/1/1/-1/0/0; their results were not manufactured by the command adapter. Root review SHA256 5f9414e05fedcd2e89c03b89efea8585ec39b774a1d9705293dbe2a76b60c312.

Root accepts finite routine proposal SHA256 798d7d263e540ed26fc5fcb1e0033a279f5acf48a6873d4282f4ba7666708a6c and authorizes the existing source worker to change only internal/release/publisher_release.go for this addition. Before ARCHIVE_VERIFIED, actual resolved Go must authenticate the exact public module/version using a new empty owned cache, minimal consumer and explicit ordinary public proxy/SumDB environment. Complete actual JSON, cache files, h1 and full archive content must agree with the accepted target. Existing archive-consumer proof remains mandatory and separate. The existing 600-second command budget is clipped by the actual parent; the holder's explicit seven-second parent is a test input, not a new production knob. Service/signature/nonzero process without independently proven mismatch remains NOT_EXECUTED/PROXY_UNAVAILABLE; deadline is NOT_EXECUTED/BUDGET_EXHAUSTED; proven identity/content mismatch is RED/PUBLISHED_ARCHIVE_MISMATCH. TAG_PRESENT and read-only probe semantics remain intact.

The original publisher assertions remain fixed. A shared test adapter successor may map only the exact public proxy and checksum endpoints/trust key to owned real services, execute actual Go and preserve all negative boundaries; its integration requires separate readback. No product endpoint override, GOSUMDB=off, synthetic Go success, CLI/schema change or live execution authorization is introduced. The preceding full internal/release regression passed 206/206 test nodes at the exact original source tree in 655.932 seconds; this scoped result does not establish full D4, publication, main delivery or issue closure.
